"""Verification harness for sympy issue 12096 (evalf + _imp_ recursion).
Runs the 2016 sympy checkout on py3.14 via compat shims (verification only;
the shims live here, not in the project).
"""
import collections
import collections.abc
import inspect
import sys

# --- compat shims for old sympy on new python (NOT part of the fix) ---
for _n in ("Mapping", "MutableMapping", "Sequence", "Iterable", "Callable",
           "Hashable", "MutableSet", "MutableSequence", "Set"):
    if not hasattr(collections, _n) and hasattr(collections.abc, _n):
        setattr(collections, _n, getattr(collections.abc, _n))
if not hasattr(inspect, "getargspec"):
    inspect.getargspec = inspect.getfullargspec

sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/work/sympy-12096-nopanel")
import sympy
print("sympy from:", sympy.__file__)

from sympy.utilities.lambdify import implemented_function
from sympy import Float, sqrt, sin

f = implemented_function('f', lambda x: x ** 2)
g = implemented_function('g', lambda x: 2 * x)

r1 = f(2).evalf()
r2 = g(2).evalf()
r3 = f(g(2)).evalf()
r4 = f(g(f(2))).evalf()
print("f(2).evalf()        =", r1)
print("g(2).evalf()        =", r2)
print("f(g(2)).evalf()     =", r3)
print("f(g(f(2))).evalf()  =", r4)

assert str(r1) == "4.00000000000000", r1
assert str(r2) == "4.00000000000000", r2
assert str(r3) == "16.0000000000000", r3
assert str(r4) == "64.0000000000000", r4

# deeper nesting + precision is honored
h = implemented_function('h', lambda x: x + 1)
assert str(f(g(h(2))).evalf()) == "36.0000000000000", f(g(h(2))).evalf()
assert f(g(2)).evalf(5) == Float(16, 5), f(g(2)).evalf(5)

# unevaluated symbolic args still come back through _imp_ as a Float
assert isinstance(f(sqrt(2)).evalf(), Float)

# non-implemented functions unaffected (mpmath path)
assert str(sin(1).evalf()) == "0.841470984807897", sin(1).evalf()

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
